description: Report settings per art (taeglich|woechentlich|monatlich|jaehrlich): aktiv (send at all; default false — nothing is sent unasked), speichern (store as document, default true), empfaenger (user ids of this tenant, list_tenant_users), bei_rot_empfaenger (additionally on red fitness, e.g. the tenant's responsible person), kanaele (mail = full report via the team mail path, whatsapp = short version via the person's WhatsApp session, dokument = stored row viewable in /app/agents → Entwicklung). Appended with person and timestamp; the latest per art wins. Without settings: stored, not sent. Admins (humans) only. Returns the effective settings of all arts.

art.description: Report period the settings apply to

bei_rot_empfaenger.description: User IDs who additionally receive it on red fitness

empfaenger.description: User IDs of this tenant who receive the report

speichern.description: Store the report as a document; default true

name: set_bericht_einstellungen
